name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a junior silver-gold explorer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos project in Salta Province, Argentina, carrying a Measured and Indicated resource of 102 Mt grading 65 g/t Ag and 0.62 g/t Au. The company is in the advanced exploration stage and received approval under Argentina's RIGI investment regime in early 2026, positioning the project for a development decision. It also holds an option and joint venture with Teck on the La Coipita property in San Juan Province.
